meaning: 把我震惊到跌倒（惊掉下巴）
usageNote: 夸张表达「震惊到不行」！口语感超强，比shocked还带劲，朋友聊天专用！

examples.en: The news of his promotion knocked me to the floor — I never saw it coming!
examples.zh: 他升职的消息让我惊掉下巴，完全没料到！

examples.en: Her singing knocked me to the floor. She sounds like a professional!
examples.zh: 她的歌声震惊了我，唱得跟专业歌手一样！
